name: rereadme
description: CLI tool to refresh README automatically with up-to-date information based on code contents, documents, and external sources
author: Connor Ludwig

scripts.setup: git submodule update --init experiments/datasets/express-server experiments/datasets/rereadme && cd experiments && uv sync
scripts.eval: cd experiments && NO_COLOR=1 uv run deepeval test run test_express_server.py test_rereadme.py test_express_server_agents.py test_rereadme_agents.py -v
scripts.eval:rereadme: cd experiments && NO_COLOR=1 uv run deepeval test run test_rereadme.py test_rereadme_agents.py -v
scripts.eval:agents: cd experiments && NO_COLOR=1 uv run deepeval test run test_express_server_agents.py test_rereadme_agents.py -v
